title: Canonical total tensor comparison and its summand formula
statement: Given an open immersion j, the existing coefficient sheaf R, a braided structure on ordinary module restriction G, and preservation by G of coefficient-sized coproducts, construct the canonical natural isomorphism between restricting the total tensor and taking the total tensor of the restrictions. On each degree-(p,q) summand its map is the inverse ordinary tensorator followed by the target summand inclusion.

source.place: Tag 0FPQ: tensor product of complexes; canonical comparison from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.Bifunctor.

proof.text: Transport the supplied coproduct preservation across Discrete.equivalence Equiv.ulift to the fibre of integer addition in each degree. The canonical mapBifunctorComparisonNatTrans induced by the inverse ordinary tensorator is an isomorphism. Uncurry it to obtain clopenTotalComparison. Its equation on summands is exactly map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX.

theorem clopenTotalComparison_summand
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
    (h : (ClopenData.clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided)
    (hcolim : ∀ K : Type (max u (t + 1)), PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete K)
      (ClopenData.clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R)) :
    ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (ClopenData.clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R) ℤ)
      (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n),
      (ClopenData.clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R).map
          (ClopenData.clopenTotalTensorSummand.{t, u} R P Q p q n hpq) ≫
          ((clopenTotalComparison j R h hcolim).hom.app (P, Q)).f n =
        (ClopenData.clopenTensorComparison.{t, u} j R h (P.X p) (Q.X q)).hom ≫
          ClopenData.clopenTotalTensorSummand.{t, u}
            ((ClopenData.clopenTensorRings.{t, u} j).obj R)
            ((ClopenData.clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R).obj P)
            ((ClopenData.clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R).obj Q) p q n hpq
